data.title: The Fractured Archive
data.statement:
THE FRACTURED ARCHIVE

An archive contains [[N]] chambers and a changing set of undirected doors. You must answer connectivity queries as doors are opened and closed.

Two chambers are connected if there is a path between them using doors that are currently open. Every chamber is connected to itself.

data.stubGenerator:
read N:int Q:int
loop Q read operation:string(100)
data.inputDescription:
The first line contains two integers N and Q: the number of chambers and the number of operations.

Each of the next Q lines contains one operation:

+ id u v
- id
? u v

Chamber numbers are from 1 to N.
data.outputDescription:
For every operation of type '?', print YES if the two chambers are connected, or NO otherwise.

Print one answer per line, in the order of the queries.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

THE FRACTURED ARCHIVE

An archive contains N chambers and a changing set of undirected doors. You must answer connectivity queries as doors are opened and closed.

Two chambers are connected if there is a path between them using doors that are currently open. Every chamber is connected to itself.
Input
The first line contains two integers N and Q: the number of chambers and the number of operations.

Each of the next Q lines contains one operation:

+ id u v
- id
? u v

Chamber numbers are from 1 to N.
Output
For every operation of type '?', print YES if the two chambers are connected, or NO otherwise.

Print one answer per line, in the order of the queries.
Constraints
2 ≤ N ≤ 5,000
1 ≤ Q ≤ 600
1 ≤ u, v ≤ N
1 ≤ id ≤ 1,000,000,000

Every removed door is currently open.
Every addition uses a door identifier that has never been used before.
At least one connectivity query is present.
Example
Input
5 9
+ 10 1 2
+ 11 2 3
? 1 3
- 10
? 1 3
+ 12 3 4
? 1 4
+ 13 1 2
? 1 4
Output
YES
NO
NO
YES
